detailed_results.query: What is the minimum attendance requirement for theory and laboratory courses?
detailed_results.reference: Students must maintain minimum 75% attendance in theory courses and 80% attendance in laboratories to be eligible for semester examinations.
detailed_results.generated:
**Official Academic Policy regarding Attendance:**

MINIMUM ATTENDANCE REQUIREMENT
1.1 Every student is required to maintain a minimum attendance of 75% in aggregate across all registered courses (theory, laboratory, tutorials, and project work) in each semester to be eligible to appear for the end-semester examinations. [attendance_policy.txt, p.1] 1.2 To qualify for appearing in the End-Semester Examination, a candidate must have:
    a) Maintained minimum 75% attendance in theory and 80% in laboratories. [examination_regulations.txt, p.1] 1.3 Attendance in all pre-placement training modules (quantitative aptitude, logical reasoning, verbal communication, DSA coding bootcamps, and mock interviews) must be at least 85%.
